title: To be or to do?
coreMove: Choose the task that deepens contribution when status and useful work begin pulling in different directions.
sourcePressure: Aspire section: status identity versus contribution. Supported by frozen source sidecar.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning the choice into anti-career posturing instead of a live test of loyalty when incentives split.

sourceAnchors.name: John Boyd
sourceAnchors.detail: The source sidecar identifies Boyd as the central anchor for choosing contribution over rank, prestige, and flattering recognition.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Boyd should enter as the fork made visible: be somebody in the room, or do the work that may cost you the room.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person 'You' direct address, retrospective 'It took her three weeks to see', question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside only if source-supported, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference where source anchors allow it
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
